## Projects

- **AI-Based FIR Document Analysis & Information Extraction** — NLP pipeline that extracts names, dates, locations, and incidents from unstructured police FIR documents (PDF parsing, tokenization, regex), with an LLM-powered natural-language Q&A layer. https://github.com/Ahamedshakir02/firai
- **Real-Time GPS & IMU Safety Monitoring App (TailSafe)** — ESP32 firmware reading a Neo-6M GPS and MPU6050 IMU, streaming over BLE and WebSocket into a React Native app, with automatic accident SOS detection, geofencing, live maps, and offline microSD logging. https://github.com/Ahamedshakir02/TailSafe
- **Disease Diagnosis Prediction with an ANN** — tuned multi-layer artificial neural network achieving 98%+ test accuracy, rigorously evaluated with a confusion matrix, precision, recall, and F1. https://github.com/Ahamedshakir02/Strokeprediction-ML
- **µLearn Mobile App — Onboarding UX** — end-to-end 8-screen onboarding redesign for an app used by thousands of Kerala students, from low-fi wireframes to usability-tested high-fi prototypes; reduced onboarding steps by 30%.
